name: Shayan Eskandari
description: Shayan Eskandari is a security researcher, hacker, and internet freedom activist working across blockchain, security, and digital rights. His Web3 arc runs from information systems PhD to smart contract auditing to CTO of an early publicly traded Ethereum staking operation. He co-founded IranUnchained and has taught Farsi-speaking communities since 2015. His current obsession is Mother of all VPNs (MoaV.sh), distributed censorship-circumvention infrastructure built before the crisis.
